Overview

ReDU links standardized sample information with public tandem mass-spectrometry datasets, enabling researchers to locate public files by organism, biospecimen, phenotype, disease state, and other metadata and to select data for reanalysis or co-analysis through GNPS.

Detailed capability map

What can this tool do?

Metadata-based contextualizationRepository-scale spectral search

Common uses

  • Filter public mass-spectrometry data by sample metadata.
  • Select public datasets for GNPS reanalysis or co-analysis.

Scope and considerations

Designed for

  • Contextualizing and reusing public tandem mass-spectrometry data using standardized metadata.

Important requirements

  • Repository records need sufficiently structured sample information to support the desired query.

Considerations

  • Metadata completeness varies among historical public datasets.
